blurb: A heartfelt thank you to everyone who supported the Historical Society of Ocean Grove by attending and participating in our 57th Annual House Tour! As our biggest fundraiser of the year, this event directly impacts our work. Every ticket purchased and donation made goes directly toward the $100,000 annual operating costs for the HSOG Museum and the preservation of our town’s cherished historic landmarks.
